High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[IG-88 (Decipher Errata 1998)]] (the card with its Decipher errata text and the errata mark) (Dagobah, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/IG-88 _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1qp3TTF2xf8mY5q0h_-uOgR1TGyWOrZp4/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>IG-88 _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,020 bytes, SHA-256 <code>be865895f8dab6f5601a47e3f84c1a7d8ddd32a073b0586dbac4ef37d9ddfd39</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 46.0, 47.5, 74.0, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

This is a fan print, not a Decipher or Players Committee card. It is listed in the card's versions list as “strangewayes print (fan re-set, not a PC or Decipher publication)” and is not shown on [[IG-88 (Decipher Errata 1998)]] (Bill, 22 November 2026).

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
